title: Attractions in Granada other than the Alhambra.
text: We are a group of 54 people who have made the route of Isabel the Catholic, and the experience has been very satisfying for the good work of the two guides who have accompanied us, and for the very interesting places we have visited.
author: S18KZricardop

title: Amazing Alhambra Tour and Guide!
text: Paola was an excellent tour guide! She has extensive knowledge and passion about the Alhambra and her city, and is happy to share it all. Paola tailored the tour to our particular needs, as one of us has a disability.  She demonstrated  great kindness and practicality.  The Alhambra is an amazing place - not to be missed. We really benefited  from a private tour, and highly recommend this company and particularly Paola. Thank you for lifelong memories!
author: Andrea Y

title: Cathedral sightseeing tour

title: Good visit

author: clubsenderismoe

title: The best experience in Alhambra
text: During my trip to Alhambra we saw many important things and best of all, our guide was explaining us about its history. For me it was an unforgettable trip as I learned a lot about the history of Granada and Alhambra Castle. One of the best things was the knowledge and passion to explain from our guide who made us understand our walk very well. For me the best parts were when the guide gave real life examples but always focusing on the history of alhambra.
author: Mariana101010101910

title: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED FOR ALL OF YOU.
text:
I highly recommend this company to all of you. Gemma responded very quickly to all my questions and attended to all my last minute changes. I changed my itinerary everyday, not once she was mad or angry at me..she fullfilled all my request with a smile. 

Gemma herself  is a good guide. We love her so much. Her story telling is precise and quirky. Funny beautiful lady. She gave us alot of tips such as food recommendation, off the beaten place for veranda, terrace that overlooked al hambra. she has so much to telll ...we just did not have enough time with her

Pablo, the driver ..he chauffered

title: Great tour!
